en: A vintage, monochrome postcard view of a narrow street leading to the ornate façade of a Baroque-style church. The building has a triangular pediment, several arched windows and niches with religious artwork, and a decorated entrance portal. Multi-story classical buildings line the right side of the street. The card has scalloped edges and printed title text at the top.
